title: Intrinsic slot-shift square for synchronized basic system generators
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, the strict coefficient-system operations $o$, and a supplied integral realization record $R$ [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. Use the fixed operation, reduction, and total-limit shift comparisons [def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data]. Let $I$ be finite, $X_i$ and $W$ schemes over $\operatorname{Spec}D.k$, and let $e,t$ be geometric expressions [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain] whose occurrence-label maps are injective [def-pur-integral-expression-occurrences]. For integral input objects $K_i$, a label $i$, and $r\in\mathbf Z$, put $K'=K[i\mapsto K_i[r]]$. Assume that both expressions have their full normalized bounded constructible domains at $K$ and $K'$. Let a single synchronized basic generator [def-pur-synchronized-canonical-maps] give actual system maps $s:e(\mathcal RK)\to t(\mathcal RK)$ and $s':e(\mathcal RK')\to t(\mathcal RK')$ and their ringed integral partners. Suppose the explicit variable-context searches at $i$ give contexts $c,d$, with their evaluation endpoints at $\mathcal R K_i$ and $\mathcal R(K_i[r])$ equal to the respective expression evaluations. Form $\chi_e,\chi_t$ by the reduction-shift mate, the selected context's fixed shift and these endpoint equalities, as in treeSubexpressionShift [lem-pur-realization-tree-shift-transport]. Then intrinsically in the derived system category, before total limit, $s'\,\chi_t=\chi_e\,s[r]$ (diagrammatic order). This is only the local system square. It asserts neither an integral square nor closure under outer contexts nor existence of a synchronized shifted evaluation.

proof.text: For a primitive isomorphism or inverse, adjunction unit or counit, direct-image or open compositor, normalized open base change or either open projection slot, use the corresponding systemAdjunctionOpenMapShift square. The injective occurrence-label maps give a unique selected path. All branches off that path remain fixed, so this is exactly the designated first or signed second tensor slot. Naturality in the selected reduction-shift isomorphism and the explicit endpoint equalities conjugates that slot-context equation to the displayed treeSubexpressionShift equation.

proof.text: For proper/open interchange use the explicit clopen factorization of lambda: pull restriction, J_s to S_s, and the direct-image compositor. The component projection is degreewise (x,y) to (x,0), and the clopen identification is identity on its supported component; both commute with cochain shift. The open adjunct of lambda inverse therefore has its fixed shift square. For exchange in any commutative square use the actual unit--pull-composition--counit right-mate formula. The adjunction shift identities hold globally for the specified adjoint-mate shifts; pasting gives its square, without a cartesianness assumption. For projection paste the unit, pull/tensor square and the counit tensor identity, retaining the selected tensor side. Compactification exchange/projection paste with beta/open projection. These are the explicit algebraic calculations underlying the conditional properOpenProjectionShift theorem; do not infer its extra intermediate-domain tests from endpoint domains, and do not apply its cartesian-only exchange constructor to a general square. Work with the degreewise primitive maps and global adjunction identities before domain restriction. Support expansion is identity for the same open/proper composite. Naturality in the selected reduction-shift map and the endpoint equalities then gives the displayed square. These cases exhaust SynchronizedBasic.

theorem canonicalTreeGeneratorSystemShift (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (o : Operations l E) (R : Realizations l E D o) :
  ∀ {I : Type u} [Finite I] {X : I → Over (Spec (.of D.k))}
    {W : Over (Spec (.of D.k))} (e t : Expression _ I X W)
    (_ei : Function.Injective e.occurrenceLabel) (_ti : Function.Injective t.occurrenceLabel)
    (_ge : e.geometric) (_gt : t.geometric)
    (K : ∀ i, Integral l E (X i).left) (i : I) (r : ℤ)
    (_he : e.domain l E o K) (_ht : t.domain l E o K)
    (_heNew : e.domain l E o (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))
    (_htNew : t.domain l E o (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))
    (s : e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K) ⟶
      t.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K))
    (v : e.ringedObj l E R.ringedModels K ⟶ t.ringedObj l E R.ringedModels K)
    (sNew : e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj
        (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧))) ⟶
      t.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj
        (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧))))
    (vNew : e.ringedObj l E R.ringedModels (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)) ⟶
      t.ringedObj l E R.ringedModels (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))
    (_g : SynchronizedBasic l E o R.compositors R.openComparisons R.canonicalBridge
      R.properOpen R.ringedModels R.ringedOpenComparisons R.ringedProperOpen
      ((inputReduction l E X).obj K) K
      ((inputReduction l E X).obj (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))
      (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)) e t s v sNew vNew),
    (c : Expression.SlotContext (systemInterpretation l E o) (X i) W) →
    (hc : e.variableContext (systemInterpretation l E o)
      ((inputReduction l E X).obj K) i = some c) →
    (hOld : c.evaluate.obj ((calculus l E (X i).left).reduction.obj (K i)) =
      e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) →
    (hNew : c.evaluate.obj ((calculus l E (X i).left).reduction.obj ((K i)⟦r⟧)) =
      e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj
        (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))) →
    (d : Expression.SlotContext (systemInterpretation l E o) (X i) W) →
    (hd : t.variableContext (systemInterpretation l E o)
      ((inputReduction l E X).obj K) i = some d) →
    (kOld : d.evaluate.obj ((calculus l E (X i).left).reduction.obj (K i)) =
      t.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) →
    (kNew : d.evaluate.obj ((calculus l E (X i).left).reduction.obj ((K i)⟦r⟧)) =
      t.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj
        (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))) →
    sNew ≫ (treeSubexpressionShift l E o t K i r d hd kOld kNew).hom =
      (treeSubexpressionShift l E o e K i r c hc hOld hNew).hom ≫ s⟦r⟧'
